reason: Classic flare: 1-cadence impulsive rise, exponential decay over ~25 min; equally present in SAP; no SAP_BKG or centroid excursion (centroid shift during peak <0.004 pix => source within ~0.2 pix / ~4 arcsec of the target photocentre); >2 d from momentum dumps; not at a segment edge; no simultaneous excursion in the 3 other hosts on S95 cam 1; no 512 flags.

Only 3 cadences above 3 sigma, peak 4.0 sigma, ED 4.7 s. Rise/decay shape and SAP are consistent with a small flare, but the same star (S95) produces negative-going 3-cadence excursions of similar significance (false_alarm.csv: 3.7 sigma at BTJD 3887.90) and ~3 ppt dips, so it is not distinguishable from noise/systematics. Not counted in rates.

Not flare-shaped: gradual ~1.5 h rise to a flat top, ~4.5 h total (auto shape test passes only because the peak point falls early in a noisy plateau). Preceded by a SAP_BKG spike at BTJD ~2220.20 and accompanied by a centroid excursion at ~2220.37; camera 1 (closest to the ecliptic) => most likely a Solar System object crossing the background annulus and then the aperture.

Detrending artifact at the ingress of an unmasked ~10 ppt, ~8 h transit-like dip (fitted mid-time BTJD 3837.926 +/- 0.001); also fails the rise/decay shape test. Only Tc1/Tc2 are masked by design. See README note: this is an additional transit of the duotransit candidate, offset ~6.6 h from the Tc1/Tc2 linear ephemeris.
